title: Main-loop register transfer
statement: For natural numbers $C,d,x_0,a,b,e,p$ and any binary input, starting at the program's main-loop label with register values $(x_0,a,b,0,e)$ and input position $p$, the program reaches its return-to-transfer label with register values $(x_0,0,b+a x_0,0,e)$ and the same input position, appending no output, in at most $a(7x_0+4)+1$ steps, uniformly for every output string already printed.
